scope: All 50 narrative readings, seven-part sequence, selected live reader routes and selected PDF pages. No public changes.
verdict: The intended message is clear and the ending earns the opening. History serves an inquiry into people, literature, audiences and continuing creative work. No new blocking factual contradiction surfaced in this editorial pass; this is not a fresh source-by-source certification.
keep: The first-person introduction and its question about writers' livelihoods.
The seven-part order; no wholesale reordering.
Named working experiences, literary passages, translators, musicians, technicians and community organisers.
The distinction between Odia language, Odisha geography, Sambalpuri work and cross-language careers.
Careful treatment of film recognition, restoration, healthcare programme outcomes and commercial estimates.
The five effectuation principles, their practical examples and explicit safeguard against unpaid labour.
The final dhaga and invitation to makers and audiences; no new conclusion or time-bound plan.
